findings.title: Account UI loses parameter interpolation for error-invalid-multivalued-size
findings.body: The account console renders this key with i18next, not Java MessageFormat. `js/apps/account-ui/src/i18n.ts:25-29` keeps i18next's default interpolation, which is `{{x}}`. `js/libs/ui-shared/src/user-profile/utils.ts:74-85` passes the server's params as `{0: min, 1: max}` to `t(...)`. The rest of this file uses `{{0}}`: it has 25 occurrences. The old value `Attribute {{0}} must have at least {{1}} ...` worked. The new value `Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}.` reaches the user as literal text, `{2,choice,...}` included, and nothing reports an error. Keep the `{{0}}`/`{{1}}`/`{{2}}` form here. If plurals are wanted, use i18next's own plural mechanism instead of Java choice syntax.

findings.title: Admin UI loses parameter interpolation for error-invalid-multivalued-size
findings.body: This has the same problem as the account-ui file. The admin console also translates user-profile server errors through `setUserProfileServerError` in `js/libs/ui-shared/src/user-profile/utils.ts:64-90`, which uses i18next `{{n}}` placeholders. The new `{0}`/`{1}`/`{2}` and `{2,choice,...}` will show up as literal text. I did not read the admin-ui i18n setup; I'm assuming it also uses i18next's default interpolation, like this file's former `{{0}}` value. Restore `{{0}}`, `{{1}}` and `{{2}}`.

findings.title: Lithuanian totpStep1 replaced with an Italian sentence
findings.body: `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:` is Italian. Lithuanian users of the account theme will now see an Italian instruction in the OTP setup step. The same Italian string was also put into `themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/login/messages/messages_lt.properties:71` (loginTotpStep1). Use a Lithuanian translation of the English text ("Install one of the following applications on your mobile:"), for example `Įdiekite vieną iš šių programėlių savo mobiliajame telefone:`. You could also delete the key so that English is the fallback.

findings.title: Lithuanian loginTotpStep1 replaced with an Italian sentence
findings.body: `loginTotpStep1=Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:` is Italian, but this is the Lithuanian login bundle. Lithuanian users who configure OTP on the login page will see Italian text. Replace it with a Lithuanian translation, or remove the key so that English is the fallback.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese bundle now has a Traditional Chinese string
findings.body: `在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：` is written in Traditional characters (手機, 安裝, 應用程式). Every other line of this zh_CN file uses Simplified characters; the next line is `打开应用扫描二维码输入验证码`. The zh_CN login bundle uses `在您的移动设备中安装以下任意一个应用：` for the equivalent key. Use the Simplified form, for example `在您的手机上安装以下应用程序之一：`.

findings.title: Anchor mismatch message omits the key and file
findings.body: `"Didn't find anchor tag " + matcher.group() + " in original string"` leaves out the key and the file. The Illegal HTML message at line 111 includes both. When this fires during a build over dozens of bundles, nobody can tell which translation to fix. Add `key` (already passed in and unused) and `file`.

contracts.action: New verifySafeHtml step runs on every verified message file, loading the English sibling bundle
contracts.equivalent_path: verifyNoDuplicateKeys in the same verify(); it reads the file and only appends messages
contracts.before_after: Before: only duplicate keys were reported. After: each key is compared against the English value. Anchors must match the English anchors in order (lines 150-162). Only br/p/strong/b are allowed, and only when the English string contains a tag (lines 58-63, 91).
contracts.visible_effect: The verify() result now also holds 'Illegal HTML' and 'Didn't find anchor tag' entries.
contracts.failure_mode: If the derived English file (lines 74-75) does not exist, a RuntimeException is thrown instead of a MojoExecutionException. The build fails with 'unable to read file'.
contracts.open_question: Which message files does the Mojo pass to verify()? Does every one of them have an English counterpart at the path derived by the regex replacement?

contracts.action: error-invalid-multivalued-size value changed to MessageFormat choice syntax in the account-ui and admin-ui bundles
contracts.equivalent_path: The rest of the same bundle uses i18next `{{n}}` placeholders
contracts.before_after: Before: `{{0}}`, `{{1}}` and `{{2}}` were interpolated by i18next. After: `{0}` and `{2,choice,...}` are not interpolated.
contracts.visible_effect: The user-profile size validation error shows raw placeholders in the account and admin consoles.
contracts.failure_mode: Silent: no error, the text is just wrong.

summary:
This PR adds an OWASP-sanitizer check to the theme verifier and fixes broken HTML in many translation bundles. The verifier logic and its tests hold up. Some of the message edits introduce user-visible regressions:
- The account-ui and admin-ui English bundles switch `error-invalid-multivalued-size` from i18next `{{n}}` placeholders to Java MessageFormat `{n}` and `choice` syntax. Both consoles translate this key with i18next, so users would see the raw placeholders.
- The Lithuanian `totpStep1` (account) and `loginTotpStep1` (login) are now an Italian sentence.
- The zh_CN account `totpStep1` uses Traditional Chinese characters in a Simplified Chinese bundle.

One minor point: the anchor-mismatch message leaves out the key and the file.
